# pantechdynamics_certificate (Resource)

A public TLS certificate, issued free by a publicly trusted CA through Pantech and renewed automatically from 30 days before it expires. Names in an active Pantech DNS zone of your organization are validated by Pantech; for any other name, add the CNAME in validation_records at your DNS host once (it keeps renewals automatic while it stays). The private key never leaves Pantech unless exportable is true (see pantechdynamics_certificate_export). A certificate a Pantech service uses cannot be deleted. At most 100 certificates per organization.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Names in a Pantech DNS zone of your organization are validated by Pantech:
# create waits until the certificate is issued, usually within two minutes.
resource "pantechdynamics_dns_zone" "example" {
  name = "example.com"
}

resource "pantechdynamics_certificate" "site" {
  names = ["example.com", "*.example.com"]

  depends_on = [pantechdynamics_dns_zone.example]
}

# A name at another DNS host needs one CNAME, listed in validation_records.
# To add it from the same configuration, do not wait for issuance: the
# certificate is issued by itself once the CNAME is in place.
resource "pantechdynamics_certificate" "partner" {
  names             = ["api.example.org"]
  wait_for_issuance = false
}

output "cnames_to_add" {
  value = pantechdynamics_certificate.partner.validation_records
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `names` (List of String) 1 to 100 DNS names, in lower case, internationalised names in punycode, wildcards as "*.example.com" (the whole left-most label). The first is the common name when it is at most 64 characters. Changing them requests a new certificate.

### Optional

- `description` (String) A note for yourself, at most 255 characters. Defaults to "". Changes in place.
- `exportable` (Boolean) Whether the certificate and its private key can be exported (pantechdynamics_certificate_export). Defaults to false: only Pantech services can use it. Set at creation and never changed: changing it requests a new certificate.
- `key_type` (String) "ecdsa-p256" (the default) or "rsa-2048". Changing it requests a new certificate.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))
- `wait_for_issuance` (Boolean) Whether create waits until the certificate is issued, up to the create timeout (default 20 minutes); a certificate still validating then is kept, with a warning. Defaults to true. Set false when names are validated by CNAMEs that this same configuration adds from validation_records at another DNS host: create then returns at once, and the certificate is issued once the CNAMEs are in place.

### Read-Only

- `common_name` (String) The first name, when it is at most 64 characters; null otherwise.
- `failure_code` (String) When failed: for example "validation_timeout" (the CNAMEs were not in place within 72 hours) or "caa_forbidden". Null otherwise.
- `fingerprint_sha256` (String) SHA-256 of the certificate, lower-case hex, once issued. It changes at every renewal.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the certificate, starting with cert_.
- `issuer` (String) The issuing CA's name, once issued.
- `not_after` (String) End of validity, in RFC 3339 UTC, to the second. It moves at every renewal.
- `not_before` (String) Start of validity, in RFC 3339 UTC, to the second.
- `pending_reason` (String) While pending: "awaiting_cname", "awaiting_dns", "awaiting_ca", "rate_limited", "ca_unavailable" or "validation_failed". Null otherwise.
- `renew_after` (String) When the next renewal starts, in RFC 3339 UTC, to the second.
- `serial_number` (String) The certificate's serial number, in hexadecimal, once issued. It changes at every renewal.
- `status` (String) "pending_validation", "issuing", "issued", "renewing" (the current certificate keeps working), "expired", "revoked" or "failed".
- `validation_records` (Attributes List) The DNS records to add at your DNS host for names outside Pantech DNS, one per challenge name (names such as example.com and *.example.com share one). Empty when every name is in a Pantech DNS zone. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--validation_records))

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).


<a id="nestedatt--validation_records"></a>
### Nested Schema for `validation_records`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) The record's name, such as "_acme-challenge.api.example.org".
- `type` (String) Always "CNAME".
- `value` (String) The CNAME's target.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# A certificate Pantech issues is imported by its id. (A certificate you
# imported yourself belongs to pantechdynamics_certificate_import.)
terraform import pantechdynamics_certificate.site cert_06ggfbabcdefghjkmnpqrstvw
```
